propositions: Eight CI lanes lack per-test hang guards (--timeout and --timeout-method=thread), allowing deadlocked tests to hide behind whole-job timeout defaults
Operator decision calibrates per-lane timeout budgets from observed historical runtime data (10x mean per-test duration, floored at 300s) rather than applying one blanket timeout across all lanes

Detection rule in test_ci_workflow_parity.py exhaustively scans all .github/workflows files for pytest invocation forms (bare pytest, python -m pytest, path-prefixed variants) and asserts each carries both --timeout and --timeout-method=thread flags

Per-test budgets range from 300s (offline unit tests) to 3600s (structured-output single sweep test), with live-service lanes (Jira DC, LLM matrix) receiving 900s and synchronous live-service lanes receiving 600s
_optionality.yml degradation-path step installs pytest-timeout into its minimal clean venv alongside pytest so the added timeout flag is honored rather than erroring as unknown
Work landed at commit 22602d81bd after frowsy-beggarly-mammoth gate fix merged; all 11 acceptance criteria verified and eight lanes now carry calibrated per-test hang guards
